threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: CT confirmation email showed EUR 700.80 vs EUR 600 in Airtable for a Bologna hotel job; root cause was a Hotel Pools line item added to the wrong parent record/Job ID.
threads.note: Ricardo identified the Hotel Pools line item was sharing a Livit Job ID with an unrelated job and is splitting it into its own parent record now.
